    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every control point carried through the mapping.
    Deform(self: CubicBezier3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): CubicBezier3D
        => (mapping(self.P0), mapping(self.P1), mapping(self.P2), mapping(self.P3));

    //==
    // # Helices and spirals

    // x = R cos theta, y = R sin theta, z = Pitch * (theta / one turn).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helix
    Eval(self: Helix, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(self.Radius * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos,
                                 self.Radius * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin,
                                 self.Pitch * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Turns);

    // A conical spiral: the winding radius interpolates across Radii while the
    // curve climbs Height over the full sweep.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conical_spiral
    Eval(self: ConicalSpiral3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(self.Radii.Lerp(t) * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Cos,
                                 self.Radii.Lerp(t) * self.Angles.Lerp(t).Sin,
                                 self.Height * t);

    // A spherical spiral (loxodrome): the inclination sweeps a half turn from
    // pole to pole while the azimuth completes TurnCount revolutions.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_spiral
    Eval(self: SphericalSpiral3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Sin * (t * self.TurnCount).Turns.Cos,
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Sin * (t * self.TurnCount).Turns.Sin,
               self.Radius * (t * 0.5).Turns.Cos);

    //==
    // # Knots and classical space curves

    // The (p,q) torus knot: r = MajorRadius + MinorRadius cos(q phi),
    // x = r cos(p phi), y = r sin(p phi), z = -MinorRadius sin(q phi).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_knot
    Eval(self: TorusKnot, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               (self.MajorRadius
                + self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Cos)
               * (t.Turns * self.AxisWindings.ToNumber).Cos,
               (self.MajorRadius
                + self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Cos)
               * (t.Turns * self.AxisWindings.ToNumber).Sin,
               -self.MinorRadius * (t.Turns * self.TubeWindings.ToNumber).Sin);

    // The trefoil knot in symmetric canonical form:
    // x = sin t + 2 sin 2t, y = cos t - 2 cos 2t, z = -sin 3t.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trefoil_knot
    Eval(self: TrefoilKnot, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               self.Scale * (t.Turns.Sin + 2.0 * (t.Turns * 2.0).Sin),
               self.Scale * (t.Turns.Cos - 2.0 * (t.Turns * 2.0).Cos),
               self.Scale * -(t.Turns * 3.0).Sin);

    // The figure-eight knot: x = (2 + cos 2t) cos 3t, y = (2 + cos 2t) sin 3t,
    // z = sin 4t.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure-eight_knot_(mathematics)
    Eval(self: FigureEightKnot, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(
               self.Scale * (2.0 + (t.Turns * 2.0).Cos) * (t.Turns * 3.0).Cos,
               self.Scale * (2.0 + (t.Turns * 2.0).Cos) * (t.Turns * 3.0).Sin,
               self.Scale * (t.Turns * 4.0).Sin);

    // Viviani's curve: x = R(1 + cos t), y = R sin t, z = 2R sin(t / 2).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viviani%27s_curve
    Eval(self: VivianiCurve, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Frame.FramePoint(self.Radius * (1.0 + t.Turns.Cos),
                                 self.Radius * t.Turns.Sin,
                                 2.0 * self.Radius * (t.Turns / 2.0).Sin);
}
